Where deep science meets large-scale reality

Dive into the most complex frontiers of physics and engineering. At Quantum Source, your curiosity drives meaningful innovation in a supportive environment.

The Vision

We are laying the groundwork for practical, large-scale quantum computing. Our path is paved by deep science, rigorous engineering, and a long-term commitment to the future.

The Challenge

We tackle the most complex puzzles in physics and technology with curiosity and integrity. We believe that the world's greatest breakthroughs happen through thoughtful collaboration.

The Expertise

At Quantum Source, you work alongside industry leaders. We blend high-level research with the engineering precision needed to make quantum systems a reality.

If you’re looking to grow, learn, and contribute to something that truly matters - Quantum Source is a place where your work can shape the future.

Why work with us

Life at Quantum Source balances intense intellectual challenge with a supportive, energizing environment.

Our multidisciplinary teams bring together people from different backgrounds, disciplines, and stages of life, creating a culture where learning never stops and ideas evolve through collaboration. We value independence alongside teamwork and shared responsibility.

Beyond the work itself, we invest in the human side of building a company. From company trips and happy hours to volunteering activities, social events, and shared moments of celebration – we believe strong connections fuel great work. The atmosphere is ambitious yet approachable, focused yet fun – a place where people feel trusted, challenged, and inspired to do their best work.

Life at Quantum Source

Our culture is built on respect, humility, and mutual trust. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse environment, where different perspectives, beliefs, ages, and experiences are welcomed and valued. We believe that diversity of thought strengthens both our technology and our teams.

Quantum Source supports the well-being and growth of its people through competitive benefits, flexibility, opportunities for learning and development, and a workplace that encourages balance and sustainability. We celebrate achievements together - with shared experiences, and moments that build team spirit. Above all, we offer the chance to be part of a bold mission - pursued with seriousness, optimism, and the confidence that it can be achieved.
